Opt-Out Management 
Enabled
Deliver a customized, end-to-end compliance experience for your users. Set the opt-in, opt-out, and help keywords and messages on a global basis as well as add per-country and per-language overrides.
Edit Standard Opt-Out Keywords
Opt-out

When users send these keywords to a Twilio Sender, they will be added to your service blacklist, and will receive a confirmation opt-out message.

Reserved Opt-out keywords:
stop
Keywords
Enter up to 20 keywords separated by commas.
Confirmation Message
Enter a confirmation message that users will receive upon sending an opt-out response.
Opt-in

When users send these keywords to a Twilio Sender they will be eligible to receive messages and will be removed from your service blacklist if they have previously opted-out. They will receive a confirmation opt-in message.

Reserved Opt-in keywords:
start
unstop
Keywords
Enter up to 20 keywords separated by commas.
Confirmation Message
Enter a confirmation message that users will receive upon sending an opt-in response.
Help

When users send these keywords to a Twilio Sender, they will receive an automated help message, which you can customize below.

Reserved Help keywords:
help
Keywords
Enter up to 20 keywords separated by commas.
Confirmation Message
Enter a confirmation message that users will receive upon sending a help response.
